page.overview:
Who is Rai Mamezuku?

Rai is a reclusive plant appraiser, secretly employed by the Higashikata Fruit Company and only known by Norisuke Higashikata IV. Once attacked by the Rock Humans, he joins with Josuke Higashikata in order to protect himself.

Rai is a Stand User, and his Doggy Style confers him the ability to transform into band-like strings.

Rai is a well-built man with braided dark hair. He is off medium build and wears a jumpsuit with a vine and a peapod pattern over a light-colored shirt and a tie, as well as a hat with an oversized flap covering the whole back of his head.

Rai's left hand is missing four fingers due to Brain Storm infecting it.
